claim: SAEs can reasonably recover protein structure prediction performance even with high sparsity (8 to 32 active latents).
falsifier: Train SAEs on a protein language model with varying sparsity levels (number of active latents) and measure reconstruction of structure prediction logits; the hypothesis predicts that performance degrades gracefully with sparsity.

exclusions: Evidence is limited to SAEs trained on ESM2-3B and the specific reconstruction metric; transfer to other models or tasks is unestablished.
